findings.summary: the negative control does not reproduce the defect: the base arm reports repaired == [] so it never opens the round the node claims to prevent
tests line is prose and the arm commands carry placeholder paths, so promotion cannot re-run the gate from the record
promotion_in_flight duplicates the lease reader at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:231
repair_held is reported for runs that owe no repair round, reading as a prevention that did not happen
reformat-only hunks landed in the change commit despite the manifest saying they were reverted

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node's goal is that a floor-driven repair and a promotion never both proceed; reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:890 now reads promotion's cross-host claim before composing a round, and reckon/crew/promotion.py:268 is the reader it asks.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when asks three cases driven on a seeded run whose review leaves one dimension below its floor, with the base revision as the control that starts a round; tests/test_a_floor_repair_and_a_promotion_are_exclusive.py:236-288 drives the first two and the base arm reddens, but it reddens on the reported holder and not on a started round.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares four source modules, the new test file and an evidence fragment; every path in the diff is inside them (git diff --stat 415ac3c9..e31da84a names exactly those six).
VERDICT manifest: read; it reports the head arm 2 passed and the base arm 1 failed 1 passed, names /home/ITER/mcintos/.cache/reckon-floor-repair/logs/gate-head.txt and gate-base.txt, and both logs exist with a bare EXIT= line.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit (one commit, e31da84a8d); it adds promotion_in_flight, owed_floor_repair, the repair-door hold, the resume lease read, the receipt field and the two-case test, plus four unrelated reformat hunks in promotion_checks.py.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:dispatch_awaiting_reviews (reflex sweep, reached from reckon/crew/recovery.py:192 and reckon/crew/resumption.py:2678), reckon/crew/promotion.py:_complete_locked (crew complete), reckon/crew/resumption.py:hold_against_promotion (reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1445 and reckon/crew/resumption.py:290), reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:owed_floor_repair (reckon/crew/promotion.py:2100)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 16
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:890-908 holds the round and reports the holder.
SCORE evidence: 8
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the base arm at gate-base.txt opens no round (report["repaired"] is empty), so no assertion in tests/test_a_floor_repair_and_a_promotion_are_exclusive.py:265 measures a started round being prevented, and the done-when's importer arm has no log.
SCORE scope_discipline: 14
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path is inside the declared write paths but reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:1278-1400 and :3159 carry reformat hunks unrelated to the change, which the manifest says were reverted.
SCORE durability: 12
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_floor_repair_and_a_promotion_are_exclusive.py:267 reddens if promotion_in_flight is removed, but no assertion reddens if the claimed prevention is lost, because the base arm never starts a round either.
SCORE fit: 17
JUSTIFICATION fit: promotion.py:268 and promotion_checks.py:787 follow the surrounding docstring-first style and carry no name the naming rules forbid.
SCORE reuse: 5
JUSTIFICATION reuse: promotion.py:268 duplicates the lease reader at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:231, and promotion_checks.py:787 duplicates the floor resolver at reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:141 with a different resolution.
FINDING tests/test_a_floor_repair_and_a_promotion_are_exclusive.py:265 blocking: the negative control does not reproduce the defect the node repairs; gate-base.txt shows the base pass reporting repaired == [] and reports == [], so the base never opens a round and the assertion report["repaired"] == [] passes on both arms, leaving the plan's declared control (the first case's reflex pass starts a round) unmet.
FINDING manifest.md:15 blocking: the tests line is a prose sentence rather than the literal command, and baseline_suite/after_suite carry base-tree and worktree placeholders, so promotion cannot fill its gate receipt from a command it can re-run.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion.py:268 non-blocking: promotion_in_flight re-implements the promotion-lease read that reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:231 already owns for the same lease name, so a second reader of one claim now exists.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:787 non-blocking: _declared_dimension_floors duplicates reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:141, resolving the same floors by checkout_path where the owner resolves them by project config, so the two can disagree about one standard.
FINDING reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:895 non-blocking: repair_held is reported for every run whose promotion claim is held, including runs whose review owes no floor repair, so the report reads as a prevented round where none would have been opened.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:1278 non-blocking: reformat-only hunks (also :1290, :1395, :3159) landed in the change commit although the manifest states they were reverted, which hides what the commit did.
